title: DesignSpecs: A DESIGN.md Dataset of Visual Design Specifications for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.17713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While AI agents increasingly generate and modify user interfaces, they rarely rely on a visual design specification for a certain project. The DESIGN.md format, which originated from Google's AI design tool Stitch and which was open-sourced in April 2026, addresses this gap by describing a visual identity through design tokens (such as named colors, text styles) and Markdown prose. To our knowledge, no large-scale research dataset of such design specification files exists. We present DesignSpecs, a dataset of 36,906 DESIGN.md files from 15,794 public, non-fork GitHub repositories, representing 17,240 unique file contents. We collected 613,207 files named DESIGN.md in October 2026. Because the same file name also denotes architectural plans and other design documents, we filtered those with YAML front matter, a design-system name, at least one recognized design token, and zero errors under the official linter. translated_abstract: 尽管AI智能体越来越多地生成和修改用户界面，但它们很少依赖针对特定项目的视觉设计规范。DESIGN.md格式起源于谷歌的AI设计工具Stitch，并于2026年4月开源，它通过设计令牌（如命名颜色、文本样式）和Markdown文本来描述视觉识别，从而填补了这一空白。据我们所知，目前尚不存在此类设计规范文件的大规模研究数据集。我们提出了DesignSpecs，这是一个包含来自15,794个公开、非分叉GitHub仓库的36,906个DESIGN.md文件的数据集，代表17,240个唯一的文件内容。我们于2026年10月收集了613,207个名为DESIGN.md的文件。由于相同的文件名也被用于表示建筑规划和其他设计文档，我们通过YAML前置元数据、设计系统名称、至少一个可识别的设计令牌以及官方linter零错误等条件对这些文件进行了筛选。我们的JSON Lines数据集提供……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个大规模DESIGN.md视觉设计规范数据集DesignSpecs，包含来自15,794个公开GitHub仓库、经严格筛选的36,906个设计规范文件，为AI智能体在生成和修改用户界面时提供视觉设计规范的数据基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DesignSpecs, the first large-scale dataset of DESIGN.md visual design specification files—36,906 carefully filtered files from 15,794 public GitHub repositories—providing a data foundation for AI agents to rely on visual design specifications when generating and modifying user interfaces.
